# IKB - recording into this knowledge base

Add to this knowledge base with `ikb RECORD --option value ...`; you need nothing else - not SQL, not the layout of the files.

- A text option takes its text from a file with `@FILE`, or from standard input with `@-` (`--found @-`): long text and apostrophes need no quoting. `@@x` is the text `@x`.
- A record is checked before it is kept; a wrong call says what is wrong and what is accepted, and nothing is changed. A record of an id that exists replaces it.
- After a record `ikb` runs `tad canon` and `tad render` (`--skip-render` to batch several records and run them once), and says one line. Then land your change.
- `--id` is made from the brief when you leave it out; `--date` is today; `--by` is `$OCOECO_BY`.
- `ikb help RECORD` is this section alone; `ikb man` is the man page.

## Records

### `ikb backlog`

An item of work ahead of a place, or done (an item of that id is replaced).

```
ikb backlog --project STRING --title STRING [--id STRING] [--status STRING] [--note STRING] [--waits STRING] [--about STRING] [--opened DATE] [--needs STRING] [--proof STRING]
```

- --project: the place: docs, lab-tools, surya-lab, device-template, sxmo-deviceprofiles
- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: what it is
- --status (default open): open, in-progress or done
- --note: where it stands, and the next step
- --waits: what it waits on, if anything (the author, a SIM card)
- --about: what it is about: a component, feature, milestone, device or backlog item (tad q about lists them)
- --opened (date, default today): when it was opened
- --needs: phone: it cannot be done without the phone - its keeper's queue (tad q phone-queue)
- --proof: the test whose pass proves it done (a tests id, or the test still to write)

### `ikb backlog-needs`

Put an item of work on a shared resource's queue (needs phone: the phone keeper's, tad q phone-queue), with the

```
ikb backlog-needs --project STRING --id STRING [--needs STRING] [--proof STRING] [--rank INTEGER]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: the item
- --needs: phone (not given: it needs nothing shared)
- --proof: the test whose pass proves it done (kept as it was when not given)
- --rank (integer): where it stands in the queue, by the author's order: 1 first (kept as it was when not given)

### `ikb backlog-status`

Where an item of work stands now: its status, and its note when one is given (the rest is kept).

```
ikb backlog-status --project STRING --id STRING --status STRING [--note STRING]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: the item
- --status: open, in-progress or done
- --note: where it stands, and the next step (kept as it was when not given)

### `ikb concept`

An idea a piece of work rests on (a concept of that id is replaced).

```
ikb concept --project STRING --id STRING --name STRING --summary STRING [--why STRING] [--about STRING]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: a-short-name
- --name: its name
- --summary: what it is
- --why: why it holds
- --about: what it is about: a component, feature, milestone, device or backlog item (tad q about lists them)

### `ikb decision`

A decision of a place of linux-phone-oco, with what was rejected (a decision of that id is replaced).

```
ikb decision --project STRING --brief STRING --decision STRING --why STRING [--id STRING] [--rejected STRING] [--about STRING] [--research STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --project: the place: docs, lab-tools, surya-lab, device-template, sxmo-deviceprofiles
- --id: YYYY-MM-DD-what-was-decided (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --brief: the decision in one line, at most 200 characters: what answers show
- --decision: what was decided
- --why: why: the evidence, the author's words
- --rejected: what was weighed and not chosen, and why not
- --about: what it is about: a component, feature, milestone, device or backlog item (tad q about lists them)
- --research: the research it rests on (its id)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb device`

A phone the project tracks (a device of that id is replaced). Its soc joins it to the SoC families view,

```
ikb device --id STRING --name STRING --codename STRING --soc STRING [--notes STRING]
```

- --id: vendor-codename
- --name: the phone's marketing name
- --codename: its codename
- --soc: Qualcomm CHIP (Snapdragon NAME)
- --notes: what is known of the phone as a whole, and where it is not measured here

### `ikb problem`

A sign seen: something that does not fit the whole - stale, overlapping, lacking or unclear (a sign of that id

```
ikb problem --project STRING --id STRING --what STRING --kind STRING --by STRING [--seen DATE] [--countermeasure STRING] [--handled DATE]
```

- --project: the place it is seen in
- --id: a-short-name
- --what: what is seen
- --kind: stale, overlapping, lacking or unclear
- --by: who saw it (patrol, bring-up, ...)
- --seen (date, default today): when
- --countermeasure: how the whole was refined
- --handled (date): when it was

### `ikb research`

What was learned, and from where (a research of that id is replaced). Its finding is the row; its own

```
ikb research --project STRING --brief STRING --question STRING --found STRING [--id STRING] [--sources STRING] [--about STRING] [--material STRING] [--supersedes STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --brief: what was found, in one line of at most 200 characters: what answers show
- --question: what was asked
- --found: what was found, condensed
- --sources: the sources' ids, comma-separated
- --about: what it is about: a component, feature, milestone, device or backlog item (tad q about lists them)
- --material: its folder, research/SUBJECT/YYYY-MM-DD/
- --supersedes: the research it is a later version of (its id)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb session-log`

How a stretch of work went: what was done, considered and rejected (an entry of that id is replaced).

```
ikb session-log --project STRING --title STRING --done STRING [--id STRING] [--considered STRING] [--rejected STRING] [--about STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: YYYY-MM-DD-what (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: in a few words
- --done: what was done
- --considered: what was considered
- --rejected: what was rejected, and why
- --about: what it is about: a component, feature, milestone, device or backlog item (tad q about lists them)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb source`

A source research and decisions cite (a source of that id is replaced).

```
ikb source --project STRING --title STRING --url STRING [--id STRING] [--author STRING] [--year INTEGER] [--by STRING] [--takes STRING]
```

- --project: the place
- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: its title
- --url: https://...
- --author: who wrote it
- --year (integer): when
- --by: who made what it describes
- --takes: what we take from it

### `ikb summary`

How a subject stands, in short: written - or renewed in place - when tad q about shows it due. It

```
ikb summary --about STRING --says STRING [--date DATE]
```

- --about: the subject (tad q about lists them, and which are due)
- --says: how it stands, in at most 1500 characters, naming the records that carry it
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb test`

A test the phone's health suite makes, and what its pass proves (a test of that id is replaced).

```
ikb test --id STRING --component STRING --proves STRING --says STRING
```

- --id: the check's name, as the suite says it
- --component: the part it is about (a components id)
- --proves: present (the part is there) or works (it does its work)
- --says: what a pass says, in a sentence

## Asking

Answer from a query, never from `data/` or `docs/`: `tad q NAME --option value` (`--format csv` for long answers).

- `tad q about [--subject] [--whole]` - Everything known of one subject, the short answer first: how it stands (its summary, dated), its status on
- `tad q backlog [--project]` - The work ahead: every item not done, of one place or of all, the one in progress first.
- `tad q coverage [--device]` - What the tests do not yet prove: every part of a device whose work no test on that device proves -
- `tad q decisions [--project] [--since]` - The decisions of one place or of all, the latest first.
- `tad q find --text STRING` - Where something is said: the id and brief of every record that says it, in any case, the latest first.
- `tad q next [--about]` - The work ahead: what is in progress, then what is open, the newest first - with what it is about and
- `tad q phone-next [--project]` - What the phone's keeper takes now: the top row of phone-queue that waits on nothing, in one row - the
- `tad q phone-queue [--project]` - The phone's queue: the work that cannot be done without the phone, in the order its keeper takes it up -
- `tad q phone-stands` - How the phone stands: the latest hand-over its keeper left (a session_log entry of surya-lab whose id ends
- `tad q recent [--days]` - What was recorded lately, the newest first: decisions, research, work opened and the log, each by its
- `tad q research [--project]` - What was learned, by one place or by all, the latest first.
